about:
Our company’s history goes back to August 1999 where Mr. Cyrus ASILI, our CEO, started his International Education and Immigration Agency called Newton Group, which became one of the industry’s well known Agencies in the field of International Education.

It wasn’t long before we started offering Real Estate Brokerage Services to our Clients and by 2018 we Managed to Sell Over $10M of Property in Turkey and by 2020 we had Sold $8M worth of property in the UAE putting ASILI Holding on the map as a serious player within the International Property Market.
testimonial1: “I bought my first investment property through ASILI Holding and am very happy with the service I received. Mr. Asili provides personalised advice and spends a lot of time making sure his clients are happy.”
testimonial2: “A great company to use for your every property need. My enquiry was a delicate one, I was travelling to London with my daughter over the summer and I needed a shortlet flat close to Regents Park. Everything went very smoothly.”
testimonial3: “Thank you Mr. Asili for the great service. I purchased three apartments off plan in Dubai and managed to get a great deal. I highly recommend ASILI Holding.”
deals:
We at ASILI Holding (UK) only Represent the Best and the Most Reputable Developers from Around the World to Make Sure that We Offer Unbeatable Investment and Living Opportunities. We Carefully Vet All Developers and Vendors to Determine whether their Projects (or Properties) are Legitimate and will Only Refer a Property if We are Absolutely Sure About the History and Reputation of the Developers.

We also Examine Investment Deals to Make Sure the Properties We Present to Our Clients are Worth the Money Paid for them. With ASILI Holding, Clients Always Come First.
history: Founded in 1999, ASILI Holding Ltd. evolved from Newton Group, a successful International Education and Immigration Agency, into a premier global real estate brokerage. Over two decades, we expanded into the property market, securing multimillion-dollar sales across Turkey and the UAE. Today, ASILI Holding Ltd. is a trusted name in real estate, offering exclusive investment opportunities worldwide.
